title: baseharbor.profile-container/v1 (outer container schema)
description: Outer portable container that carries the non-secret management-access/v1 records plus the codec version and destination path. The container carries no secret: the record's secret blob is never present; only the non-secret record and the encrypted export envelope (algorithm/encrypted/nonce) are carried.

dest_path.description: Destination-relative path the record was produced at; never a producer absolute path.
